about: DPS too soon (Moroes room clear): the Banquet Hall room clear pulls the west Phantom Guest formation (leader 135233) with the three pathing Skeletal Waiters and the two west Ghostly Stewards kept around it. In tr-20260927-210901-8 the room-clear camp released the party 1s after aggro with the casters 20-31yd out and an OT/rogue chased north into guests and Moroes; in tr-20260927-003140-1 a Waiter 16415 engaged the hunter from 45yd with no attributed carrier. 114d70a7 (camp box, clean lanes, roomCampFight anchored leashes) is on master but not live-tested, and the Waiter carrier is still unexplained. O1 is the oracle that sees the casters-out release (guests parked 26-29yd on the tank in both runs of lb-20261003-155828-1). Waiter 135310 is not kept: its loop leg (-11011,-1931)->(-10965,-1937) crossed the old start and scout-aggroed the party at ~2.4s every run. The start sits east of the stairwell opening (no navmesh at z79 around -10975..-10990,-1942..-1953; the old start dropped bots to z25-33).
